year_start.label: Year starts on
year_start.description: MM-DD, such as 05-20 for a birthday. Empty: January 1.

year_label.label: Year label
year_label.description: Up to 8 letters. Empty: the year, such as 2026.

month_start.label: Month starts on day
month_start.description: Such as a payday. In shorter months, their last day.

month_label.label: Month label
month_label.description: Up to 8 letters, such as PAY. Empty: the month, such as NOV.

custom_label.label: Own span label
custom_label.description: Up to 8 letters, such as BABY.

birth_date.label: Birth date
birth_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, for the life views. Empty: no life views.

life_years.label: Life, years
life_years.description: The span of the life views.
